## Validation and assumptions

No seed articles were supplied. PubMed returned zero records for the matching systematic-review search. I screened 90 candidates from the pilot sample and two category probes; 17 were included in the development set. The strategy retrieved **17/17 (100%)** of those records. This is development relative recall, not independent validation or absolute sensitivity. The second category probe found 0 relevant records among 30 screened; the first found one eligible farmed-eel study, so I expanded the scope and search terms to include farmed aquatic animals.

The cutoff is implemented as the required **Entrez date** bound through February 22, 2019; no `[dp]` publication-date limit was added. Counts reflect the current PubMed index restricted by that Entrez-date bound, not an archival reconstruction of PubMed as it existed in 2019. The MeSH Virome heading was excluded because it was introduced after the cutoff.

The internal PRESS-structured critique passed after documenting the required cutoff. This draft still needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use. A remaining risk is that studies using sequencing methods without explicit metagenomic or viromic wording may be missed. The [audit](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-def605b9b5df8f15/ours-codex-noseed-20260929T033207Z/work/audit.md) and [assumptions and risk notes](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-def605b9b5df8f15/ours-codex-noseed-20260929T033207Z/work/narrative.md) contain the full record of the build.
